description: Add languages to the workspace's export languages, which gives products, categories and brands a translation tab in each of them and makes them targets for a bulk translation. Languages already offered are ignored, and none is ever removed. Use list_content_locales first to see what is offered. Idempotent. The result names what was added and echoes the workspace.

locales.description: Languages to add to the workspace's export languages, ISO 639-1. Languages it already offers are ignored.

name: add_content_locales
title: Add export languages
